live_check_note: report-debt-governance-gates --check --changed-from-ref origin/main exited 1 on dirty WT (module_coverage_scorecard_coherence, generated_artifact_drift). HEAD-committed mismatch is AUD-TD-001.

findings.observation: На origin/main HEAD 5c4243c9 committed remote-main baseline всё ещё pin 4aa9f5e7, а snapshot debt-governance-gates держит inventory 2465/3c15f12f при том, что module-coverage-inventory и architecture-quality-scorecard уже 2466/97945b43.
findings.claim: Committed remote-main baseline SHA and gates inventory snapshot lag origin/main HEAD.
findings.method: git show HEAD:reports/quality/architecture-debt-remote-main-baseline.json; git show HEAD:reports/quality/debt-governance-gates.json; git show HEAD:reports/quality/module-coverage-inventory.json; git rev-parse origin/main
findings.expected: remote_main_sha == origin/main; gates inventory hash equals committed module-coverage-inventory source_tree_sha256; generated_artifact_drift count=0 on a clean tree.
findings.actual: HEAD baseline remote_main_sha=4aa9f5e7f7d22de7233dc666e8dd8c2bd205940e fingerprint=d6b88081...; gates coherence snapshot source_module_count=2465 source_tree_sha256=3c15f12f...; inventory+scorecard source_module_count=2466 source_tree_sha256=97945b43...; origin/main=5c4243c9adad87f4a8eb4a6b0228e4b65841810e.
findings.impact: Release-gate snapshot на main не доказывает freshness текущего origin/main; CI с --changed-from-ref обязан пересобрать baseline/gates.
findings.broken_invariant: REQ-GOV-012: debt/quality generated artifacts stay coherent with origin/main.
findings.root_cause: Committed remote-main baseline SHA and gates inventory snapshot lag origin/main HEAD
findings.remediation: На чистом дереве (без grafana/http WIP) выполнить report-architecture-debt-remote-main-baseline --update и report-debt-governance-gates --update/--check --changed-from-ref origin/main. Не поднимать бюджеты.

evidence.output: HEAD remote_main_sha=4aa9f5e7... origin/main=5c4243c9... baseline inv 2465/3c15f12f vs inventory 2466/97945b43

findings.acceptance: Clean-tree --check --changed-from-ref origin/main: drift count=0 and remote_main_sha equals origin/main.
findings.rollback: Revert only the regenerated quality snapshots; do not change scorecard max_count.

findings.observation: Named ratchet max_assertless_tests=87, live assertless_total_candidates=88 (86 intentional_no_exception_contract + 2 architecture_helper_guard); refined_assertless_tests=0. S9 test проверяет только max_assertless_tests<=102, не live<=max.
findings.claim: Named assertless ratchet max_assertless_tests is below live assertless_total_candidates and S9 gate does not compare live count.
findings.expected: Live assertless_total_candidates <= max_assertless_tests; gate сравнивает live с yaml. Не повышать yaml.
findings.actual: yaml max=87; report assertless_total_candidates=88; refined=0; weak_no_value=0; test_s9 only asserts max<=102.
findings.impact: Потолок yaml уже пробит на 1 кандидат; без live-сравнения drift не блокирует CI. Повышение max запрещено.
findings.broken_invariant: REQ-GOV-012: quality ratchet max_count is a non-increasing ceiling over live debt.
findings.root_cause: Named assertless ratchet max_assertless_tests is below live assertless_total_candidates and S9 gate does not compare live count
findings.remediation: Снять ≥1 classified candidate так чтобы live<=87; привязать S9 к live<=max. REJECTED_POLICY: 87→88.
findings.acceptance: assertless_total_candidates <= 87 and architecture test asserts live <= yaml max.
